name: pmns_theta23
formula: theta_23 = 45 deg (bare prediction; Tier 3, octant unresolved)
app_psc_precision_str: inside both NuFIT 6.0 3-sigma ranges; Delta chi^2(45 deg) = 2.0 with SK / 4.2 without; octant unresolved

extra.comparator_source: NuFIT 6.0 (arXiv:2410.05380) Table 1, normal ordering, IC24 with SK atmospheric data
extra.status_rule: OPEN_CONDITIONAL while 45 deg lies inside both NuFIT 6.0 3-sigma ranges and the octant is unresolved (DUNE / Hyper-K decisive); TENSION otherwise
extra.note: The bare 45 deg prediction lies inside the NuFIT 6.0 3-sigma ranges with and without SK atmospheric data. The earlier 4.09-sigma figure, a one-octant Gaussian on 49.5 +/- 1.1 deg, is withdrawn: 45 deg is not in >3-sigma tension and the octant is unresolved.
